trigger_tokens.description: Provider-reported input tokens at which a closed Episode is summarized; null: trigger_ratio of the hard input limit alone.

trigger_ratio.description: null: the watermark is trigger_tokens; a ratio: max(trigger_tokens, ratio x hard input limit) (v4/v5), or the ratio alone when trigger_tokens is null.

checkpoint_target_tokens.description: The checkpoint length asked of the compactor (estimated tokens).

checkpoint_max_tokens.description: The checkpoint's soft maximum (estimated tokens), telemetry.

enabled.description: false only when a context pack turns rollout compaction off.

retry_attempts.description: Same-source attempts of one Episode's capsule.

retry_backoff_action_steps.description: Completed ActionSteps a rejected attempt waits, doubling per attempt.
